                                        ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1 Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance is
hereby amended by changing all of RS-2 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 14-J in the area bounded by:

        West 59 Place; a line 250 feet east of and parallel to South Lawndale
        Avenue; the public alley next south of and parallel lo West 59'*^ Place; and a
        line 200 feet east of and parallel to South Lawndale Avenue;

to those of a RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.
